title: Love One Another
description: Jesus said the whole world would know we belong to him by one thing: how we love each other.

waypoints.title: The Mark of a Follower
waypoints.body: The night before he died, Jesus gave his followers a new command: love each other the way he had loved them. He said that love -- not perfect knowledge or performance -- would be the sign to the world that they belonged to him.

waypoints.title: An Act of Love
waypoints.body: Do one specific act of love for a family member this week without being asked -- then write about it in the journal.
